en_title: Scrapped GTA 5 Story DLC Might Have Taken the Series Overseas for the First Time in 15 Years
cn_title: 《GTA5》废弃剧情DLC或曾计划前往巴黎
subtitle: 阳台外的埃菲尔铁塔
opus_summary: 泄露的《GTA5》文件显示，废弃的剧情DLC中有一处可俯瞰巴黎的公寓，阳台外能看到埃菲尔铁塔，但铁塔只是平面图。该DLC曾计划让崔佛担任特工，最终未能推出，部分内容后来用于《GTA Online》更新。

paragraphs.en: Grand Theft Auto 5's story DLC was seemingly going to take players to Paris, if leaked footage is anything to go by.
paragraphs.cn: 如果泄露的画面能说明问题，那么《侠盗猎车手5》的剧情DLC似乎原本会带玩家前往巴黎。

paragraphs.en: Last week, a slew of files and assets from GTA 5 surfaced online. This leak showed off variety of cut content, prompting Rockstar to take action and issue takedowns to creators who were showing it in their videos. One of the most interesting parts of this leak has been seeing all of the scrapped DLC, which includes a Liberty City map expansion .
paragraphs.cn: 上周，《GTA5》的一批文件和素材在网上流出，其中包含多种被删减的内容。Rockstar随后采取行动，向在视频中展示这些内容的创作者发出下架通知。泄露内容中尤其引人关注的是那些被取消的DLC，其中包括自由城地图扩展内容。

paragraphs.en: Fans have also uncovered new information about the game's fabled story DLC, which was formally announced by Rockstar in 2013 with a 2014 release window in mind. Unfortunately, none of it ever saw the light of day, as Red Dead Redemption 2 and GTA Online became higher priorities. One of the DLCs would've followed Trevor assuming the role of a secret agent, tackling dirty jobs for the government and assassinating powerful foes. Much of this was already known, but what fans likely weren't aware that this DLC was also seemingly going to take players to Paris.
paragraphs.cn: 粉丝还发现了有关这款游戏那批传闻已久的剧情DLC的新线索。Rockstar曾在2013年正式公布这些DLC，计划于2014年推出。遗憾的是，随着《荒野大镖客：救赎2》和《GTA Online》的开发优先级提高，它们最终都没能问世。其中一款DLC原本会让崔佛扮演特工，替政府干脏活，并刺杀有权势的敌人。这些内容大多早已为人所知，但粉丝此前可能不知道，这款DLC似乎还打算带玩家前往巴黎。

paragraphs.en: In the leaked files, players were able to look at some of the unfinished levels made for this DLC, and one of them includes some kind of luxury apartment that overlooks Paris. The Eiffel Tower can be seen outside of a balcony, though it's just a flat image rather than an explorable 3D environment. It's entirely possible that this apartment would've been the extent of the overseas adventure, potentially being used for a cutscene or maybe some kind of assassination mission.
paragraphs.cn: 泄露的文件展示了这款DLC的部分未完成关卡，其中一处有一间可俯瞰巴黎的豪华公寓。从阳台向外能看到埃菲尔铁塔，不过铁塔只是一张平面图，并非可供探索的3D场景。玩家的海外之行完全有可能仅限于这间公寓；它或许只是用于过场动画，也可能用于某种刺杀任务。

paragraphs.en: The only other time Grand Theft Auto has taken players overseas was in GTA: London 1969, which was an expansion for the original game released in 1999. Some fans have hoped to see the series go abroad, but the franchise's former writer and creative director, Dan Houser, suggested that the series wouldn't work as well outside of America .
paragraphs.cn: 《侠盗猎车手》系列此前唯一一次带玩家前往海外，是1999年推出的初代游戏扩展内容《GTA：伦敦1969》。一些粉丝一直希望这个系列能走出美国，但系列前编剧兼创意总监Dan Houser曾表示，系列作品换到美国以外的地方，可能就没那么合适了。

paragraphs.en: "I think for a full GTA game, we always decided there was so much Americana inherent in the IP, it would be really hard to make it work in London or anywhere else," said Houser in 2025. "You know, you needed guns, you needed these larger-than-life characters. It just felt like the game was so much about America, possibly from an outsider's perspective. But that was so much about what the thing was that it wouldn't really have worked in the same way elsewhere.”
paragraphs.cn: Houser在2025年说：「我觉得，对于一部完整的《GTA》游戏，我们一直认为这个IP有太多根植于美国的元素，很难把它搬到伦敦或其他地方。你知道，游戏需要枪械，也需要那些个性夸张的角色。它给人的感觉就是与美国密不可分，或许还是从局外人的视角来看美国。但这一点太能定义《GTA》了，所以换到别的地方，恐怕就达不到同样的效果。」

paragraphs.en: Trevor actor Steven Ogg has spoken loosely about the scrapped GTA 5 story DLC in the past. He shot some scenes for it, but Rockstar never followed up on the project, and that was the end of it. A former developer estimated that the DLC was about halfway finished when the plug was pulled and was sour about its cancellation.
paragraphs.cn: 崔佛的演员Steven Ogg过去曾简略谈及被取消的《GTA5》剧情DLC。他为其拍摄过一些片段，但Rockstar此后没有继续推进这个项目，事情也就不了了之。一位前开发者估计，DLC被叫停时已完成约一半；项目遭取消也让他感到不快。

paragraphs.en: “It was really really good," said ex-Rockstar Senior Camera Artist Joe Robino. "But when GTA Online came out, it was so much of a cash cow and people were loving it so much that it was hard to make an argument that a standalone DLC would outcompete that. I think looking back now you could probably do both. But that was a business decision they made. I was a little upset about that. That actually was a lot of the reason for me being a little sour at that time. Because I was like yo, WTF guys? This s**t’s awesome. Let’s keep going. Let’s finish this s**t.”
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar前高级镜头美术师Joe Robino说：「它真的、真的很棒。但《GTA Online》推出后，既那么赚钱，又那么受玩家喜爱，很难说服人相信一款独立DLC能比它表现更好。现在回头看，我觉得或许两边都能做。但他们当时做出了那个商业决定。我对此有点不满，这也是我那时心里不太痛快的一个重要原因。我当时就想：‘喂，搞什么啊，伙计们？这东西明明棒极了。继续做啊，把它做完啊。’」

paragraphs.en: With GTA 6 on the horizon, it seems unlikely we'll ever see this DLC revived, but some of it was salvaged into GTA Online updates like The Doomsday Heist.
paragraphs.cn: 随着《GTA6》即将到来，这款DLC似乎不太可能重启。不过，它的部分内容后来被用于《GTA Online》的更新，例如《末日抢劫》。
